name: Fennel oil
short: Evidence is for fennel preparations in general: trials rarely assessed adverse events and reported no serious ones. A review flags potential interactions with cardiovascular medicines.
text: The cited sources cover fennel preparations in general, not fennel oil specifically. In a systematic review of 12 randomised trials of fennel for period pain, only three studies assessed adverse events and one reported minor events; a review of seven trials in menopausal women reported no serious adverse events but judged the trials to have concerning risks of bias. A review that described antiplatelet and anticoagulant effects of fennel in experimental (in vitro and in vivo) studies flagged potential interactions with cardiovascular medicines as needing further clinical research.
